subject: MAP kickoff: Arcadia Labs — scope, owners, and 8-week close plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@arcadialabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Arcadia MAP kickoff — goals, roles, and proposed 8-week timeline

Hi Elena —

Great to meet you on Friday. As discussed, I pulled together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align on goals, owners, and an 8-week evaluation/close timeline so we can get to a production pilot with predictable SLAs. High level: we propose a 6–8 week evaluation with a short pilot phase, aiming for commercial decision at the end of week 8.

Draft goals (please confirm or edit):
- Demonstrate 2x latency improvement on our inference path for batch workloads
- Validate privacy controls (VPC + KMS) and retention settings for PHI
- Establish baseline cost-per-1k tokens with Redwood Optimize settings

Proposed timeline (week-by-week in attached MAP):
- Week 1: Kickoff, access + integrations, security questionnaire
- Weeks 2–4: Eval runs, perf metrics, prompt set validation
- Weeks 5–6: Pilot (dedicated capacity), quantization tests
- Weeks 7–8: Business review, SOW review, procurement

As next steps I want to confirm the internal owners on your side and schedule a 45-minute kickoff next week to walk the team through the MAP and assign action items. Proposed slots: Tues 12/2 10:00–10:45 PT, Wed 12/3 11:00–11:45 PT, or Thurs 12/4 9:00–9:45 PT.

Attachments: Arcadia_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), SOW-draft-Arcadia.pdf (starter).

Can you confirm:
1) That the goals above match your priorities;
2) Who the customer technical owner and procurement rep will be; and
3) Which slot works for kickoff?

Thanks — look forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs

Marissa —

Thanks — this looks like a great starting point. Goals are aligned with our executive ask; a couple of clarifications:
- We need to validate token redaction and KMS bindings as part of the security workstream.
- Procurement will want an initial SOW and a high-level TCO statement for the pilot.

Owners on our side:
- Me (Champion / Product) — elena@arcadialabs.com
- Tom Reed (Procurement) — tom.reed@arcadialabs.com
- Aisha Khan (Security) — aisha.k@arcadialabs.com
- I'll add a technical lead after I sync with infra (should be by EOD tomorrow).

We can do Wed 12/3 11:00 PT for kickoff — that works best for the group. Please send a calendar invite and a short agenda. I attached our security questionnaire (arcadia-security-questions.pdf) — please have your security/technical lead confirm where Redwood will host audit logs and how long logs are retained.

Thanks,
Elena
VP Product, Arcadia Labs
elena@arcadialabs.com
